title: Luxury 30A Vacation Home in Blue Mountain Beach with Elevator & Deck
meta_description: Salty Olive offers a 4BR/3.5BA retreat for 14 guests with an elevator, bikes, and outdoor deck—just minutes from beach access in Blue Mountain Beach on 30A.
description_expanded: AboutSalty Olive | A Luxury 30A Vacation Home in Bluewater Landing Blue Mountain Beach | 4 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 14 | Gated Community | Near Beach Access Property Highlights: • Gated community in Bluewater Landing on the south side of 30A • Elevator for easy access between floors • Just minutes to public beach access and the sugar-white sands of the Gulf • Four complimentary bikes to explore 30A's scenic trails • Add a street-legal golf cart and receive 10% off the golf cart rental rate • Open-concept living with coastal luxury décor and premium finishes • Fully stocked kitchen with modern appliances and ample prep space • Outdoor grill and spacious back deck with seating • Four backpack beach chairs and a beach umbrella included • Free high-speed WiFi and Smart TVs throughout the home • Close to 30A dining, shopping, and family-friendly entertainment • Complimentary Starbucks coffee pack, bottled water, and a full starter amenity kit Experience Coastal Luxury on 30A Welcome to Salty Olive, a beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom 30A vacation rental in the exclusive Bluewater Landing community. Located on the south side of Scenic Highway 30A, this luxury beach house offers both privacy and quick access to public beach entry points, just a short stroll or bike ride away. Surrounded by natural beauty and upscale comfort, Salty Olive is the ideal home base for exploring everything Blue Mountain Beach and 30A have to offer—from beach days and bike rides to world-class dining and boutique shopping. Modern Comfort & Thoughtful Design Step inside and enjoy a light-filled, open-concept living area featuring stylish coastal décor, comfortable seating, and a spacious layout perfect for gathering with family and friends. The gourmet kitchen is fully equipped for home-cooked meals and casual entertaining, while expansive balconies and a furnished back deck invite you to unwind outdoors. Enjoy quiet mornings with coffee, al fresco dinners on the deck, or evenings under the stars. With high-end furnishings and thoughtful amenities throughout, this home offers all the comforts of a private resort. Sleeps 14 Comfortably – Ideal for Families & Groups • First-Floor King Suite – Includes a sitting area with sleeper sofa, ensuite bath with walk-in shower • Third-Floor Primary King Suite – Features a private lounge area and spa-style ensuite • Third-Floor King Guest Room – Light, bright, and comfortably appointed • Third-Floor Bunk Room – Two twin-over-queen bunk beds, ideal for kids or multiple guests • Additional Bathrooms – A full hallway bath (shower/tub combo) and a second-floor half bath for convenience Explore 30A from Bluewater Landing Located in a gated community along 30A, Salty Olive provides easy access to some of the area's best attractions. Ride bikes to Gulf Place, walk to nearby beach accesses, or explore Seaside, Grayton Beach, and WaterColor—all just minutes away. With free WiFi, Smart TVs, beach gear, and a fully stocked kitchen, this home is designed to give you everything you need for a carefree and memorable stay on Florida’s Emerald Coast. Book Your 30A Vacation Rental Today Whether you’re seeking a family beach retreat, a group getaway, or a peaceful escape, Salty Olive delivers the ultimate combination of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. Reserve your luxury 30A vacation home now and experience the best of Blue Mountain Beach and 30A living at Salty Olive.
